'''Maigran''' was a [[Da'shain]] [[Aiel]], later [[Jenn Aiel]], who lived during the middle of the [[Breaking of the World]].

==History==
Maigran was the sister of [[Lewin]] and the granddaughter of [[Adan]]. Her parents are [[Marind]] and [[Saralin]]. Her grandfather holds her when her father was killed by bandits.{{ref/book|4|26}}

During [[Rand]]'s third step through the [[glass columns]], he saw Maigran's rescue from bandits through Lewin's eyes.{{ref/book|4|25}} Due to Lewin being cast out for having abandoned [[the Way of the Leaf]] because of Maigran's testimony, Maigran could be said to be the proximate cause of some of the Aiel abandoning the Way and separating from the Da'shain, to create the Jenn Aiel and the warrior Aiel.
